fact: Decreto-lei n.º 47/2022 (Boletim Oficial n.º 111, 24 November 2022), applying to direct and indirect State administration, requires ICT investments to ensure interoperability with other public administration information systems and data reuse under the once-only principle and to reuse the PDEX interoperability platform, and enters into force the day after publication.
title: Boletim Oficial n.º 111, I Série, 24 de novembro de 2022 (Decreto-lei n.º 47/2022)
publisher: Boletim Oficial da República de Cabo Verde
